workLog.evidence: c0d7bf451 from claude/issue-5074-merge-resolver-rename-rule replayed as 1521e2d05; bounds the observation-sync advisory under its lefthook cap and fixes three root-only permission test failures. Becomes empty on rebase once PR #5087 merges.

workLog.step: Established the GitHub Actions contract from the vendor docs rather than memory
workLog.evidence: docs.github.com expressions reference: always() 'Causes the step to always execute, and returns true, even when canceled', with the stated recommended alternative 'If you want to run a job or step regardless of its success or failure, use the recommended alternative: if: ${{ !cancelled() }}'. So !cancelled() alone still runs on failed and skipped dependencies.

workLog.step: Audited every workflow for the aggregator shape with a parsed-YAML detector
workLog.evidence: Detector: workflows triggered by pull_request or push, jobs carrying both needs and always(), whose steps reference needs.<job>.result or toJSON(needs). 24 jobs carried needs plus always(); 7 of those consume dependency results. 2 were already guarded (ai-pr-quality-gate aggregate, ai-session-protocol aggregate, both always() && !cancelled() from the #2347 fix); 5 were unguarded and were fixed.

workLog.step: Replaced always() with !cancelled() in the five unguarded aggregators
workLog.evidence: pytest.yml test-result, pytest.yml main-failure-alert, cli-smoke.yml smoke-result, installed-plugin-hook-guard.yml guard-result, test-codeql-integration.yml aggregate-results. Block scalars or ${{ }} used because a plain YAML scalar starting with ! parses as a tag.

workLog.step: Flipped the two existing tests that pinned the old always() contract
workLog.evidence: tests/workflows/test_pytest_xdist_parallelism.py::test_aggregate_runs_when_path_detection_fails and tests/test_plugin_hook_guard_aggregate.py::test_guard_result_runs_even_when_dependencies_fail now assert !cancelled() and reject bare always()

workLog.step: Added the parsed-structure regression guard with a negative control
workLog.evidence: tests/workflows/test_aggregator_cancellation_guard.py: per-job parametrized assertions plus a repository-wide sweep that re-runs the detector, and controls that rebuild each pre-fix if expression on a deep copy of the parsed job and assert the checker rejects it
